other_conditions: The applicant must have worked in building and construction for at least 90 days in a given year
The applicant must be a registered construction worker under the Karnataka Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board
The applicant must be partially disabled due to worksite accidents or diseases
The applicant must not have previously availed Accident Benefits for the same disability
Application must be submitted within 6 months of issuance of the disability ID card
Registration must be renewed every 3 years, with a 1‑year grace period after expiry
benefits_summary: Monthly disability pension of ₹2,000 and a one‑time ex‑gratia payment of up to ₹2,00,000 based on the percentage of disability.
